en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning as temperatures climb
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6:45 a.m., forecasting urban highs around 33 degrees and extremely hot conditions in some New Territories areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 6:45 a.m. on Wednesday, warning that the public should beware of heat stroke.

The Observatory said the weather would be mainly fine today, with relatively low visibility in the morning. It would be dry during the day, with a maximum temperature of around 33 degrees in urban areas and a couple of degrees higher in the New Territories. Some areas would be extremely hot.
Light winds would become moderate northeasterlies later, with isolated showers possible. The outlook for the rest of the week and the weekend remained mainly fine, hot and dry during the day.

The Observatory advised that elderly persons, pregnant women, infants and children, those with chronic illnesses and the obese are more vulnerable. People working outdoors or in high-temperature environments should take precautions, drink more water, avoid overexertion and stay in cool or air-conditioned places where possible.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 市民慎防中暑
zh.dek: 天文台於早上6時45分發出警告，預料市區最高約33度，新界部分地區更熱，局部極端酷熱。
body: 香港天文台於周三早上6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，提醒市民慎防中暑。
天文台表示，今日大致天晴，早上能見度較低。日間乾燥，市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高兩三度，部分地區極端酷熱。
吹微風，稍後轉吹和緩東北風，局部地區有駭雨。本周餘下時間至周末期間大致天晴，日間仍然炎熱及乾燥。
天文台指長者、孕婦、嬰幼兒、長期病患者及肥胖人士較易中暑。戶外工作或高溫環境工作者應採取預防措施，多飲水、避免過度勞累，並盡量留在清涼或有空調的地方。
